newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to cut highest rate of customs duty.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to cut highest rate of customs duty.

text.p: Bangladesh Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria on Thrusday proposed to reduce the highest rate of customs duty to 42.5 percent for the fiscal 1997/98 beginning on July 1 from the present 45 percent.
"We will incur substantial revenue loss due to this reduction," he said while presenting the country's new revenue budget for 1997/98.
"But such tariff reduction is essential...in keeping with the global trend of trade liberalisatiuon and to promote efficiency in the economy," he said.
